title: A Thousand Cups Drained - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: A Thousand Cups Drained trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: A Thousand Cups Drained phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The drunk boss. His timing is deliberately irregular, which makes parrying by rhythm fail - read the flash colour instead.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: Trophy 33 of 36 on the list - before it Scarlet Wraithblade · after it Master of the Misty Waters. It is not missable, so a missed run can be finished later without a restart. The full list with rarity is on the trophy list; the Platinum route and the order to do things in are on the trophy guide.
